normalisation_policy: Preserve enumerated object/table evidence without extending the CLOSED_2026-08-09 discovery or strict census. Collection-level dates do not automatically date each object.

copenhagen_desmid_objects.note: One SNM_ID may carry multiple species labels; these are retained as a list.

farlow_cheever_position_rows.note: Mixed-period current index. Rows are position evidence, not automatic nineteenth-century object dates.

st_andrews_bell_pettigrew_hierarchy.note: Collection hierarchy rows; source date ranges remain source wording.

ansp_symbiota_review_pool.note: Review-only. The query label 'pre-1900' did not reliably constrain dates; post-1900 records such as 1938 Preston Smith were returned.

ucl_whipple_mcz_targeted_pages.note: Metadata-page evidence retaining identifiers, relationship candidates and quantity candidates for manual contextual review.

sorbonne.note: The Sorbonne job was interrupted after raw pages were written and did not produce a complete summary/records layer. It is intentionally excluded from normalised evidence.

closure_boundary.new_discoveries_from_harvest: do not add silently; require later reopening/version
